panels.description: Coverage and interpretation

options.content:
### How to read this dashboard

The selected range includes sessions by **latest observed event**. Token, response, turn, and duration values cover **available observed session history**, not activity spent within the selected range, and may omit older usage or records. Recorded tokens come from deduplicated observed response records; runtime-reported tokens remain separate because they can be estimated. Model and effort are latest selected settings without per-model attribution. Activity history begins when the collector starts and is not backfilled.

title: All Sessions
